summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: @onereach/orest-vue-demi-vue2@0.0.5 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (platform-specific zip, extracted and chmod+x'd) and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob using string-array rotation and a charcode decoder (obfuscator.io shape). The obfuscated payload is opaque and has no relationship to the package's stated purpose (a Vue 2 vue-demi shim). Bun is pulled purely to execute the sibling script outside the Node module graph, evading scanners that only trace Node-resolved code. Execution fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
